e.title: **它会自己生成一份「哪些参数还没有出处」的审计报告**：**OpenFisca 突尼斯养老金模块**（PyPI `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension` 5.3.1，2026-09-10）——**把养老金规则写成** 63 份 YAML 参数**＋**13 个变量**＋**6 套制度**；**⭐ 它逐字公布自己的缺口**（**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**）**；**⭐ 它还点名一部法律的出处状态是**「**à résoudre**」**；**⭐⭐ 而它把**来源文件本身**（Word 与 Excel）**放在仓库里**
e.title_en: It generates its own audit report of which parameters still lack a source: the OpenFisca Tunisia pension module, released on the package index as version 5.3.1 on 2026-09-10, expresses pension rules as sixty-three YAML parameter files plus variables and benefit regimes, publishes its own gap counts verbatim, stating that thirty-one of fifty parameters carry a reference and nineteen do not, flags one law as still to be resolved, and keeps the source documents it transcribed from, a Word file and a spreadsheet, inside the repository.
e.title_hk: **它會自己生成一份「哪些參數還沒有出處」的審計報告**：**OpenFisca 突尼斯養老金模組**（PyPI `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension` 5.3.1，2026-09-10）——**把養老金規則寫成** 63 份 YAML 參數**＋**13 個變數**＋**6 套制度**；**⭐ 它逐字公布自己的缺口**（**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**）**；**⭐ 它還點名一部法律的出處狀態是**「**à résoudre**」**；**⭐⭐ 而它把**來源文件本身**（Word 與 Excel）**放在倉庫裡**
e.summary: **openfisca-tunisia-pension**（PyPI 发行名 `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension`，**版本 5.3.1**）**是 OpenFisca 微模拟框架下的**突尼斯养老金规则模块**：**许可 AGPL-3.0-or-later**、**要求 Python ≥3.10**、**依赖** `openfisca-core[web-api]`（**逐字钉在** `>=44.0.3,<45.0.0`**）与** `openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`；**实测最新版本 2026-09-10 上传**，**仓库提交同日**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处」**，**它把「出处」做成了**可运行的产物**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它自己生成一份参数出处审计报告**——`reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md`**（标题逐字**「**Audit sources retraite OpenFisca Tunisia Pension**」**、**首行逐字**「**Généré le 2026-09-10 par `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`.**」**）**，**并逐字公布自己的缺口**：**「**Fichiers paramètres retraite: 63**」**、**「**Paramètres avec valeurs ou barèmes: 50**」**、**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把**没有出处的那 19 个参数逐行列出来**（**含参数路径、说明与日期**）**，**并把一部法律的出处状态逐字标成**「**à résoudre**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把**来源文件本身放进仓库**——`doc/` 下有** `Tableau synoptique Régimes tunisiens SS.doc` **与** `Taux de cotisation CNSS ET CNRPS.xlsx`；**⭐⭐ ④ 规则与测试都是**数据**（**63 份 YAML 参数、**`tests/formulas/` 下另有 YAML 用例**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安装、未运行、未读任何参数值或法律条文**。
e.summary_hk: **openfisca-tunisia-pension**（PyPI 發行名 `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension`，**版本 5.3.1**）**是 OpenFisca 微模擬框架下的**突尼斯養老金規則模組**：**許可 AGPL-3.0-or-later**、**要求 Python ≥3.10**、**依賴** `openfisca-core[web-api]`（**逐字釘在** `>=44.0.3,<45.0.0`**）與** `openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`；**實測最新版本 2026-09-10 上傳**，**倉庫提交同日**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它自己生成一份參數出處審計報告**——`reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md`**（首行逐字**「**Généré le 2026-09-10 par `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`.**」**）**，**並逐字公布自己的缺口**：**「**Fichiers paramètres retraite: 63**」**、**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把**沒有出處的那 19 個參數逐行列出來**，**並把一部法律的出處狀態逐字標成**「**à résoudre**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把**來源文件本身放進倉庫**——`doc/` 下有** `Tableau synoptique Régimes tunisiens SS.doc` **與** `Taux de cotisation CNSS ET CNRPS.xlsx`；**⭐⭐ ④ 規則與測試都是**資料**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝、未運行、未讀任何參數值或法律條文**。
e.summary_en: **openfisca-tunisia-pension**, released on the package index as version 5.3.1, **is the Tunisian pension rules module built on the OpenFisca microsimulation framework**: **licence AGPL-3.0-or-later**, **Python 3.10 or later required**, depending on the OpenFisca core package with a narrow version pin and on a sibling country model package; the newest release was uploaded on 2026-09-10 and the repository was committed to the same day. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and this project turns provenance into a runnable artefact**: **it generates its own audit report of parameter sources**, titled verbatim as an audit of pension sources and stating verbatim that it was generated on 2026-09-10 by a named script, and **it publishes its own gap counts**, reporting sixty-three pension parameter files, fifty parameters carrying values or schedules, **thirty-one of those fifty carrying a reference and nineteen without one**; it then lists all nineteen parameters without a reference line by line with their descriptions and dates, and marks one law source verbatim as still to be resolved. **It also keeps the documents it transcribed from, a Word file and a spreadsheet, inside the repository**, and both its rules and its test cases are data files rather than code. **Nothing was installed, run, or read parameter by parameter this round.**
e.body:
**openfisca-tunisia-pension**（PyPI 发行名 `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension`，**版本 5.3.1**；GitHub 仓库 `openfisca/openfisca-tunisia-pension`）**是 OpenFisca 微模拟框架下的**突尼斯养老金规则模块**，**逐字自述为**「**Ceci est le code source du module Tunisien dédié aux pensions.**」（**同一句在英文段里逐字为**「**This is the source code of the Tunisian pension module.**」**）**。**本次实测**：**PyPI 最新版本 `5.3.1` 上传时间 2026-09-10**、**该 PyPI 项目共 9 个版本**；**仓库提交时间同日 2026-09-10**（**经提交 Atom 流实测**）；**默认分支是** `master`（**`main` 分支下 `README.md` 探测返回 404，而 `master` 下为 200、6,901 字节**）；**许可逐字为** AGPL-3.0-or-later（**README 逐字**「**Son code source est distribué sous la licence GNU Affero General Public Licence version 3 ou ultérieure**」**，**PyPI 分类器逐字**「**License :: OSI Approved :: GNU Affero General Public License v3**」**）**；**Python 要求 ≥3.10**；**运行依赖逐字含** `openfisca-core[web-api]<45.0.0,>=44.0.3`、`openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`、`numba`、`numpy`、`scipy`，**开发额外项含** `pytest`、`ruff`、`twine`、`yamllint`、`requests` 等，**notebook 额外项含** `ipykernel`、`jupyter-client`、`matplotlib`、`nbconvert`、`nbformat`、`pandas`；**PyPI 分类器另逐字给出** `Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable` 与 `Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Information Analysis`。**仓库文件清单经 tarball 枚举为 177 条路径**。本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处：让别人查得到，也让每个数回得去」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里把「出处」做得最**重**的一条**——**它把出处做成了一份**会重新生成的审计报告**。

**可核实信息（均仓库文件清单、README、PyPI 元数据与审计报告实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它会自己生成一份「哪些参数还没有出处」的审计报告**——`reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md`（**实测 5,811 字节**）**标题逐字为**「**Audit sources retraite OpenFisca Tunisia Pension**」**，**首行逐字为**「**Généré le 2026-09-10 par `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`.**」**，**而**生成者是** `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`（**本次实读其文件头，**逐字含一行 docstring**「**Generate a source coverage audit for pension parameters.**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 该报告的 Synthèse 一节逐字公布自己的缺口**：**「**Fichiers paramètres retraite: 63**」**、**「**Paramètres avec valeurs ou barèmes: 50**」**、**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres multi-dates: 6**」**、**「**Textes JORT locaux: 1**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**它没有说「参数都有法律依据」，而是**逐字写出 31／50 与 19／50 两个数**——**⭐ 即**「**我核到了 31 条，还有 19 条没核到**」**被写进一份**每次都会重新生成的报告**里**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把没有出处的那 19 个参数逐个列出来**——报告末节标题逐字为**「**Paramètres sans référence**」**，**表头逐字为** `Paramètre`／`Description`／`Dates`，**本次实读到的行含** `retraite.cnrps.age_legal.civil.enseignants_du_superieur`（**说明逐字**「**Age de départ à la retraite pour certains enseignants du supérieur**」）、`retraite.cnrps.pension_minimale.minimum_garanti`、`retraite.rsa.age_legal` **等**。**⭐ 即**缺口不是一句「部分参数待补」，**而是**一张带参数路径与日期的清单**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把「引用了哪些法律、各被几个参数引用、状态如何」也列成表**——报告里逐字给出**「**Textes cités dans les références**」**一节**（**表头为** `Texte`／`Occurrences paramètres`／`Statut`**）**，**本次实读到的行含**：`1959-18`（**逐字**「**Loi n° 59-18 du 5 février 1959, pensions civiles et militaires**」）**3 个参数、**状态逐字**「**JORT 1959/8, texte pivot**」；`1985-12`（**逐字**「**Loi n° 85-12 du 5 mars 1985, pensions civiles et militaires secteur public**」）**17 个参数、**状态逐字**「**JORT 1985/20, texte pivot**」；**以及** `1985-611` **4 个参数、**状态**逐字标为**「**à résoudre**」**。**⭐ 即**它连「这一部我还没找到出处」**也写在表里**，**而不是悄悄留空**——**⭐ 这与本站 [[insurance-governance]] 一类条目关注的「可追溯性」是同一件事，只是这里追溯的对象是**法律文本**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它把来源文件本身放进了仓库**——文件清单实测** `openfisca_tunisia_pension/doc/` **下有** `Tableau synoptique Régimes tunisiens SS.doc` **与** `Taux de cotisation CNSS ET CNRPS.xlsx`；**⭐ 即**「**这些参数是从哪份表抄来的**」**这个问题的答案**不只是引用，**而是一份**同仓的 Word 与 Excel**（**⚠️ 本次未打开这两个文件，**故不主张其内容与参数一致**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 规则是数据，测试也是数据**——文件清单实测** `parameters/` 下 **63 份 YAML**（**全文共 74 份 YAML**），**按制度分成** `parameters/retraite/cnrps/{accessoires 13, age_legal 7, bareme_annuite 1, bonifications 9, capital_deces 6, depart_anticipe 12, duree_de_service_minimale 1, pension_minimale 5, survivants 6}` **与** `parameters/retraite/rsa/age_legal`；**另有** `variables/` 13 条与 `regimes/` 6 条；**而** `tests/formulas/` **下的用例本身也是 YAML**（**实测含** `cnrps/pension.yaml`、`cnrps/pension_minimale.yaml`、`cnrps/salaire_de_reference.yaml`、`cnrps/taux_de_liquidation.yaml`、`rsna/pension.yaml`、`rsna/taux_de_liquidation.yaml`、`test_accessoires.yaml`、`test_depart_anticipe.yaml`），**其余测试才是 Python**（**实测含** `test_anticipe.py`、`test_bonifications.py`、`test_capital_deces.py`、`test_coordination.py`、`test_regimes_speciaux.py`、`test_survivants.py`、`test_parametres_partages.py`、`test_tools.py`）。**⭐ 即**「**用给定的输入与该给的输出表**」**被当成数据来写**，**而不是塞进断言语句里**——**⭐ 这也解释了为什么 CI 里会有一条**「**只 lint 改动过的 YAML 测试**」**的脚本**（**逐字文件名** `.github/lint-changed-yaml-tests.sh`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 发布流程是仓库里的一组脚本，而不是平台上的黑箱**——`.github/` **实测含十个自定义脚本**：`get_minimal_version.py`、`get_pypi_info.py`、`has-functional-changes.sh`、`is-version-number-acceptable.sh`、`lint-changed-python-files.sh`、`lint-changed-yaml-tests.sh`、`publish-git-tag.sh`、`pyproject_version.py`、`split_tests.py`、`test-api.sh`，**另有** `dependabot.yml`、**议题与拉取请求模板**；**工作流三个**：`workflow.yml`、`validate_yaml.yml`、`tax-benefit.yml`。**⭐ 即**「**版本号能不能接受**」「**有没有功能性改动**」「**要不要打 tag**」**这些判断都写成了可读的脚本**（**⚠️ 本次未读这些脚本的内容，**故不主张其判定逻辑**）。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 生成器要读的东西有一部分**不在仓库里**——**本次实读** `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py` **的文件头常量**，**它逐字定义** `PARAMETERS_DIR = ROOT / "openfisca_tunisia_pension" / "parameters" / "retraite"`、`JORTS_DIR = ROOT / "tmp" / "JORTs"`、**以及一个**仓库外**的 SQLite 缓存** `EXTERNAL_JORT_CACHE = ROOT.parent / "PDFs-legislation-tunisie" / "jort_cache.db"`，**并会写** `reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md` **与** `parameters_candidates/retraite_source_candidates.yml`。**⭐ 而本次的文件清单里**：`tmp/` **下只有** `tmp/manuel.txt` **与** `tmp/manuel pensions.pdf`，**没有** `tmp/JORTs/`；**也没有** `parameters_candidates/` **目录**。**⚠️ 本词条如实记录这一处**：**那份报告的表里点名了一个**本地路径**下的 JORT 法律文本文件，**而本次在该仓库的文件清单里没有找到它**——**⭐ 本词条只记录这个实测结果**，**不推测原因**（**report 是生成物，**可能在本机存在该文件的环境里生成**；**⚠️ 本次未核实** `scripts/` **下是否有忽略规则，亦未核实**该文件是否曾存在过**）。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 登记层面有两处可核查的不一致**：**①** PyPI 元数据的 `project_urls` **里** Changelog **一项逐字指向** `https://github.com/openfisca/openfisca-tunisia-pension/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md`**，**而该仓库的默认分支实测是** `master`（**本次未核实** `main` **分支是否存在**，**但** `main` **下的** `README.md` **确实返回 404**）**；**②** README 顶部的构建状态徽章**逐字指向** `travis-ci.org`**，**而文件清单里**没有 `.travis.yml`**（**`master/.travis.yml` 本次探测 404**）**。**⭐ 本词条如实记录这两处**，**不推测原因**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 它在框架里的位置本身就是一种接线**：**依赖里逐字含** `openfisca-core[web-api]>=44.0.3,<45.0.0`（**即**把核心钉在一个主版本区间内**）与** `openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`（**即**养老金模块**接在国家税制模块之上**）**；**README 逐字给出的文档入口有三个**：项目总文档 `doc.openfisca.fr`（**含逐字的**「**schéma des composants**」**组件图**）、**突尼斯立法浏览器** `legislation.openfisca.tn`、**以及一个 GitHub wiki**。**⭐ ⑩ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[openfisca]] 记录的是这个微模拟引擎本身**，**本条补上的是**一个具体国家的具体给付分支**（**养老金**）；**与 [[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[colombian-pension-observatory]]、[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]] 一类条目相比**，**本条记录的不是机构页或论文**，**而是**把养老金规则写成可执行数据**的那种做法**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[openfisca]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「社会保障类给付规则如何被写成数据、并如何被追到法条」的一个完整样本**；**其中与本词条项目自身最同构的一点是**：**它生成一份报告**逐条列出**自己哪些参数**还没有出处**，**并把其中一部法律的状态标成**「**待解决**」。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 OpenFisca、没有安装该模块、没有运行任何一次模拟、没有执行 `make` 或任何测试**，**故不主张**任何给付计算、任何参数取值、任何期限或比例**按所述工作**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**：**这是一部**社会保障法律规则**的实现**，**其法律准确性本词条完全没有核实**——**本次**未打开任何一部被引用的法律文本**（**未访问** `legislation.openfisca.tn`、**未读** `tmp/manuel pensions.pdf`、**未打开** `doc/` **下的 Word 与 Excel**）**，**故**不应据本条目采信任何法律或给付结论**；**本词条只记录它的工程做法与自述数字**。**③ ⚠️ 未读任何参数 YAML 的内容**——**本次只看到路径清单与计数**，**故不主张** 63 份参数文件的实际内容、多日期参数的处理方式、以及各制度的实际规则。**④ ⚠️ 审计报告的数字是**该报告自己生成的**（**本次**未重跑该生成器**，**未逐条核对 31／50 与 19／50 **是否正确**）；**⭐ 本词条只记录「它公布了这两个数」这一事实**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实那份报告里**「**JORT 1959/8**」一类卷期标注是否正确**，**也未核实** `1985-611` **的出处是否真的未找到**（**本次未做任何法律检索**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未读** `.github/` **十个脚本的内容**、**未读三个工作流**、**未核实 CI 当前是否通过**；**未核实** `test-api.sh` **要测的是哪个 API**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** PyPI 分类器自述的 `Production/Stable` **是否与实际情况相符**；**未核实**该模块是否被任何机构实际使用**。**⑧ ⚠️ 许可为 AGPL-3.0-or-later**（**README 与 PyPI 分类器一致**），**⚠️ 本次未读 `LICENSE` 正文**；**⭐ 顺带记录**：**AGPL 对「以网络服务形式提供」有额外要求**，**而**本条**不对其合规影响作任何判断**。**⑨ ⚠️ 仓库提交 2026-09-10 与版本上传 2026-09-10 都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「自生成参数出处审计报告 ＋ 把来源 Word／Excel 放进仓库 ＋ 公布未核实的法律关系」这一组合，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑪ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用法文时，原文里的 ASCII 撇号一律写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

**openfisca-tunisia-pension**（PyPI 發行名 `OpenFisca-Tunisia-Pension`，**版本 5.3.1**；GitHub 倉庫 `openfisca/openfisca-tunisia-pension`）**是 OpenFisca 微模擬框架下的**突尼斯養老金規則模組**。**本次實測**：**PyPI 最新版本 `5.3.1` 上傳時間 2026-09-10**、**該 PyPI 專案共 9 個版本**；**倉庫提交時間同日 2026-09-10**（**經提交 Atom 流實測**）；**預設分支是** `master`（**`main` 下 `README.md` 探測 404，`master` 下為 200、6,901 位元組**）；**許可逐字為** AGPL-3.0-or-later；**Python 要求 ≥3.10**；**運行依賴逐字含** `openfisca-core[web-api]<45.0.0,>=44.0.3`、`openfisca-tunisia>=0.80`、`numba`、`numpy`、`scipy`；**檔案清單經 tarball 列舉為 177 條路徑**。本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**。

**可核實資訊（均倉庫文件清單、README、PyPI 元數據與審計報告實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它會自己生成一份「哪些參數還沒有出處」的審計報告**——`reports/openfisca/pension_source_audit.md`（**實測 5,811 位元組**）**標題逐字為**「**Audit sources retraite OpenFisca Tunisia Pension**」**，**首行逐字為**「**Généré le 2026-09-10 par `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py`.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 該報告的 Synthèse 一節逐字公布自己的缺口**：**「**Fichiers paramètres retraite: 63**」**、**「**Paramètres avec valeurs ou barèmes: 50**」**、**「**Paramètres avec référence: 31 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres sans référence: 19 / 50**」**、**「**Paramètres multi-dates: 6**」**、**「**Textes JORT locaux: 1**」**。**⭐ 即**它沒有說「參數都有法律依據」，**而是逐字寫出 31／50 與 19／50**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把沒有出處的那 19 個參數逐個列出來**——末節標題逐字為**「**Paramètres sans référence**」**，**表頭逐字為** `Paramètre`／`Description`／`Dates`。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它把「引用了哪些法律、各被幾個參數引用、狀態如何」也列成表**——逐字給出**「**Textes cités dans les références**」**一節**；**本次實讀到的行含** `1959-18`（**3 個參數**，**狀態逐字**「**JORT 1959/8, texte pivot**」）、`1985-12`（**17 個參數**，**狀態逐字**「**JORT 1985/20, texte pivot**」），**以及** `1985-611`（**4 個參數**，**狀態逐字標為**「**à résoudre**」**）**。**⭐ 即**它連「這一部我還沒找到出處」**也寫在表裡**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它把來源文件本身放進了倉庫**——`openfisca_tunisia_pension/doc/` **下有** `Tableau synoptique Régimes tunisiens SS.doc` **與** `Taux de cotisation CNSS ET CNRPS.xlsx`。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 規則與測試都是資料**——`parameters/` 下 **63 份 YAML**（**全文 74 份**），**另有** `variables/` 13 條與 `regimes/` 6 條；**而** `tests/formulas/` **下的用例本身也是 YAML**（**含** `cnrps/pension.yaml`、`cnrps/taux_de_liquidation.yaml`、`rsna/pension.yaml`、`test_accessoires.yaml`、`test_depart_anticipe.yaml` **等**）。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 發布流程是倉庫裡的一組腳本**——`.github/` **含十個自訂腳本**（`get_minimal_version.py`、`get_pypi_info.py`、`has-functional-changes.sh`、`is-version-number-acceptable.sh`、`lint-changed-python-files.sh`、`lint-changed-yaml-tests.sh`、`publish-git-tag.sh`、`pyproject_version.py`、`split_tests.py`、`test-api.sh`）**與三個工作流**（`workflow.yml`、`validate_yaml.yml`、`tax-benefit.yml`）。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 生成器要讀的東西有一部分**不在倉庫裡**——**本次實讀** `scripts/generate_pension_source_audit.py` **的檔案頭常量**，**它逐字定義** `JORTS_DIR = ROOT / "tmp" / "JORTs"` **與一個**倉庫外**的 SQLite 快取** `EXTERNAL_JORT_CACHE = ROOT.parent / "PDFs-legislation-tunisie" / "jort_cache.db"`；**而本次清單裡** `tmp/` **下只有** `tmp/manuel.txt` **與** `tmp/manuel pensions.pdf`**，**沒有** `tmp/JORTs/`；**也**沒有** `parameters_candidates/`**。**⚠️ 本詞條只記錄這個實測結果，不推測原因**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 登記層面有兩處可核查的不一致**：**①** PyPI 的 Changelog 連結逐字指向 `blob/main/CHANGELOG.md`，**而預設分支實測是** `master`；**②** README 的建置狀態徽章逐字指向 `travis-ci.org`，**而清單裡**沒有 `.travis.yml`**（**`master/.travis.yml` 探測 404**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 它在框架裡的位置本身就是一種接線**：**依賴釘住** `openfisca-core[web-api]>=44.0.3,<45.0.0` **並接在** `openfisca-tunisia>=0.80` **之上**；**README 逐字給出三個文件入口**（`doc.openfisca.fr`、`legislation.openfisca.tn`、GitHub wiki）。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[openfisca]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「社會保障類給付規則如何被寫成資料、並如何被追到法條」的一個完整樣本**；**其中與本詞條專案自身最同構的一點是**：**它生成一份報告**逐條列出**自己哪些參數**還沒有出處**，**並把其中一部法律的狀態標成**「**待解決**」。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 OpenFisca、沒有安裝該模組、沒有運行任何一次模擬、沒有執行任何測試**，**故不主張**任何給付計算、參數取值、期限或比例**按所述工作**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**：**這是一部**社會保障法律規則**的實作**，**其法律準確性本詞條完全沒有核實**——**未打開任何一部被引用的法律文本**，**故**不應據本條目採信任何法律或給付結論**。**③ ⚠️ 未讀任何參數 YAML 的內容**（**只看到路徑清單與計數**）。**④ ⚠️ 審計報告的數字是**該報告自己生成的**（**未重跑生成器、未逐條核對 31／50 與 19／50**）。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實報告裡「**JORT 1959/8**」一類卷期標註**，**也未核實** `1985-611` **的出處是否真的未找到**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未讀** `.github/` **十個腳本與三個工作流的內容**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實**自述的 `Production/Stable` **是否相符，**未核實**是否被任何機構實際使用**。**⑧ ⚠️ 許可為 AGPL-3.0-or-later，未讀 `LICENSE` 正文**；**本詞條不對其合規影響作任何判斷**。**⑨ ⚠️ 倉庫提交與版本上傳 2026-09-10 都在解凍窗口之內**，**故本條不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但「自生成參數出處審計報告 ＋ 把來源 Word／Excel 放進倉庫 ＋ 公布未核實的法律關係」這一組合，此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑪ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用法文時，原文裡的 ASCII 撇號一律寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。

**openfisca-tunisia-pension**, released as version 5.3.1 and housed at `openfisca/openfisca-tunisia-pension`, **is the Tunisian pension rules module built on the OpenFisca microsimulation framework**. **Measured this round**: the newest release was uploaded on 2026-09-10 and the project has nine releases in total; **the repository was committed to the same day**, measured through its commit feed; **the default branch is `master`**, with a README probe returning 404 on `main` and 200 with 6,901 bytes on `master`; **the licence is AGPL-3.0-or-later**, stated in the README and matching the package index classifier; **Python 3.10 or later is required**; runtime dependencies cover the OpenFisca core package with a web API extra, pinned to a single major version, plus a sibling country model package, numba, numpy and scipy; and the file listing enumerates 177 paths from a tarball. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and it is the heaviest of the round four on provenance, because it turns provenance into an audit report that can be regenerated.**

**Verified information, all measured from the file listing, the README, the package metadata and the audit report itself**: **first, it generates its own audit of which parameters still lack a source.** The report under the reports directory, measuring 5,811 bytes, is titled verbatim as an audit of pension sources and opens verbatim by stating that it was generated on 2026-09-10 by a named script, which this round read the head of, and whose docstring says verbatim that it generates a source coverage audit for pension parameters. **Its synthesis section publishes its own gaps verbatim**: sixty-three pension parameter files, fifty parameters carrying values or schedules, **thirty-one of those fifty carrying a reference, nineteen without one**, six multi-date parameters and one local legal text. **It never claims that every parameter has a legal basis; it prints both counts.** **Second, it lists all nineteen parameters without a reference one by one**, under a heading that says so, with columns for the parameter path, its description and its dates, and lines this round read include the legal retirement age for certain higher-education teachers, the guaranteed minimum pension and the legal retirement age under another regime. **The gap is not a sentence saying some parameters remain to be completed; it is a list with parameter paths and dates.** **Third, it tabulates which laws are cited, by how many parameters, and in what state**, under a heading about the texts cited in the references, with columns for text, number of parameters and status. Lines read this round include a 1959 law on civil and military pensions cited by three parameters with a status naming a specific issue of the official gazette and calling it a pivot text, a 1985 law on public-sector pensions cited by seventeen parameters with a similar status, and a 1985 text cited by four parameters whose status is marked verbatim as **still to be resolved**. **It writes down that it has not yet found the source for one law, instead of leaving the cell blank.** **Fourth, it keeps the documents it transcribed from inside the repository**: under the package documentation directory there is a Word file described as a synoptic table of the Tunisian social security regimes and a spreadsheet of contribution rates for two named funds, **so the answer to where these parameters came from is not only a citation but a same-repository Word file and spreadsheet, whose contents were not opened this round**. **Fifth, rules and tests are both data**: there are sixty-three YAML parameter files, organised by regime into directories for supplements, legal age, annuity scales, bonuses, death capital, early departure, minimum service duration, minimum pension and survivors, alongside variables and regimes; and the test cases under the formulas directory are themselves YAML, covering pension, minimum pension, reference salary and liquidation rate for two regimes, with the remaining tests written in Python. **The expectation of given input producing given output is therefore written as data rather than buried in assertions, which also explains why one of the continuous integration scripts exists solely to lint changed YAML tests.** **Sixth, the release process is a set of scripts in the repository rather than a platform black box**: ten custom scripts cover deriving a minimal version, fetching package index information, detecting functional changes, deciding whether a version number is acceptable, linting changed Python files and changed YAML tests, publishing a git tag, reading the version from the project metadata, splitting tests and exercising an API, alongside three workflows. **Whether a version number is acceptable and whether a tag should be published are written as readable scripts whose contents this round did not read.** **Seventh, part of what the generator reads is not in the repository**: the script head defines a parameters directory, a directory for legal texts under a temporary folder name, **and an SQLite cache in a sibling directory outside the repository**, and writes both the audit report and a candidate file. In the listing this round, the temporary directory contains only a text file and a PDF manual, **with no legal texts directory, and there is no candidates directory either, so the report names a local path for a legal text that this round did not find in the repository listing; this entry records the measurement without speculating about the cause, noting only that the report is a generated artefact and may have been produced where that file existed locally.** **Eighth, two registration inconsistencies are checkable**: the package metadata changelog link points at a `main` branch while the measured default branch is `master`, and the README build badge points at a continuous integration service that no longer operates while the listing contains no configuration file for it, with a probe for that file returning 404. **Both are recorded without speculation about cause.** **Ninth, its position in the framework is itself a kind of wiring**: it depends on the core package with a narrow pin to one major version and on a sibling country model package, and its README names three documentation entry points, the project documentation including a component diagram, a Tunisian legislation browser, and a wiki. **Tenth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled `[[openfisca]]` entry covers the microsimulation engine itself, while this entry supplies one country benefit branch; compared with entries such as `[[pensions-authority-ie]]`, `[[colombian-pension-observatory]]` and `[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]]`, this entry is not an institutional page or a paper but a way of writing pension rules as executable data.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[openfisca]]**, because **it is a complete sample of how social security benefit rules get written as data and traced back to statutes**, and the part most structurally similar to this wiki own practice is that **it generates a report listing which of its parameters still have no source, and marks one law as still to be resolved**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, OpenFisca was not installed, the module was not installed, no simulation was run and no test was executed**, **so no benefit calculation, parameter value, period or rate is claimed to work as described**. **Second, and most in need of later verification: this is an implementation of social security law, and its legal accuracy was not examined at all** — no cited legal text was opened, the Tunisian legislation browser was not visited, the PDF manual was not read and the Word and spreadsheet files under the documentation directory were not opened — **so no legal or benefit conclusion should be taken from this entry, which records engineering practice and self-reported counts only**. **Third, no parameter file content was read**, only path listings and counts, so nothing is claimed about the contents of those sixty-three files, how multi-date parameters are handled, or the actual rules of each regime. **Fourth, the audit numbers are generated by that report itself**, and the generator was not re-run and the counts were not checked line by line; **this entry records only the fact that it publishes those two counts**. **Fifth, the correctness of the gazette issue references was not verified**, nor whether the source for the law marked as unresolved is genuinely unfound, since no legal search was performed. **Sixth, the ten integration scripts, the three workflows and current CI status were not read or checked**, nor was it established which API one of the test scripts exercises. **Seventh, whether the production-stable classifier the package assigns itself is accurate was not verified, nor whether any institution actually uses this module. Eighth, the licence is AGPL-3.0-or-later by the README and the package classifier, whose licence text was not read, and no judgement is offered on the compliance implications of that licence for network use. Ninth, both the commit and the release upload fall on 2026-09-10, inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the combination of a self-generated parameter provenance audit, the transcribed source documents kept in the repository, and published unresolved legal relationships had no counterpart in the pool. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Eleventh, quotation convention: ASCII apostrophes in quoted French text are rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**
